# soapysdr-module-lms7

**SoapySDR driver module for LimeSDR (LMS7002M) hardware**

- **Version recorded:** 23.11.0
- **Categories:** `hardware`, `sdr`
- **Upstream:** <https://github.com/myriadrf/LimeSuite>

## What it does

A plugin for SoapySDR that makes LimeSDR USB, Mini and XTRX boards usable through the generic SoapySDR interface, built against the classic LimeSuite library.

## Why you would want it

It is what lets one program drive many different radios. Software written against SoapySDR reaches LimeSDR hardware through this module rather than through a Lime-specific code path, so installing it is usually the difference between an application listing your radio and showing an empty device list.

## Before it will work

LimeSDR hardware and limesuite. The `limesdr` hardware entry carries three identifiers confirmed from Debian's own 64-limesuite.rules (closed 2026-08-26 without hardware — the maintainer still owns none), so udev rules for it can be generated from the catalog.

## How it installs

- apt: `soapysdr-module-lms7`

## Known problems

Built against LimeSuite 23.11, which every target still ships while upstream has moved to LimeSuiteNG. The two are not interchangeable, and a module and its library must match: a mismatch shows up as a device that is not listed rather than as an error. `SoapySDRUtil --info` reports which modules loaded and is the first thing to check.

## Keeping it current

- probe: apt policy
- strategy: apt_upgrade
